key_idea: The proof establishes the existence of the group by applying continuous random fields to prove amenability and homological stability of loop spaces to bound the Schur multiplier, deriving finite presentation from a central cover.
reason: The argument features a strikingly beautiful conceptual skeleton that brilliantly unifies disparate tools from continuous probability and algebraic topology. However, this profound high-level elegance is inevitably weighed down by the massive technical bookkeeping and dense combinatorics required to rigorously manage the piecewise translation structure.
